question: What humble request is made regarding service at the divine feet?
premises: The speaker asks for servitude at the lotus feet.
The request is presented as a declaration concerning greatness.
inference: The speaker humbly requests the gift of service at the divine lotus feet.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of māhātmyaṃ and nivedanam to the request is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: Grant me servitude at your lotus feet; this is my humble declaration of your greatness.
